statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ pricing appears contained while Brent near $110 and the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.97% keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail stays below the block threshold without persistent one-way NQ structure, while CPI creates a narrow conditional risk window.
headline: Contained NQ pricing offsets extreme oil-and-rates stress ahead of CPI
body: Investing.com displayed Sep NQ at 29,473 within 29,435.75-29,508.25. Reuters reported 10Y near 4.97% and Brent near $110. CPI is due at 12:30 UTC.

sources.title: Reuters: US 10-year yield nears 5% as oil surges

lookbackSummary: Tail reached elevated around September 10 PPI/cash open, then returned to WATCH as persistent one-way NQ structure was not retained or verified. Stress stayed extreme overnight.
outlookSummary: NQ is contained, but oil, yields and geopolitical supply risk keep Stress extreme. Main danger window: 12:15-14:30 UTC around CPI, cash open and Michigan; path quality determines Tail escalation.

forecast.analysis: Investing.com displayed Sep NQ at 29,473 within 29,435.75-29,508.25. This contained span does not show one-way structure; 10Y near 4.97% and Brent near $110 keep Stress extreme.
drivers: Contained NQ range; 10Y near 4.97%; Brent near $110
